defaultPrompt: Help me clarify what my organization does, who we serve, and why they choose us.
Assess my Mandate and suggest upgrades.
Help me prepare a Change Framework for this initiative.
interface.longDescription: IntelliVen Operations Advisor helps leaders and teams use Manage to Lead to clarify goals, align their thinking, and guide execution. Draft or refine WHAT-WHO-WHY, assess a Mandate, develop Enterprise and Initiative Change Frameworks, and compare and consolidate team perspectives. IVOA applies packaged IntelliVen tutorials and rubrics, distinguishes evidence from inference, and preserves consequential disagreements for the team to resolve.
